_comment: Canonical per-kind system default view shape (expr + params + group_by), roots fixed at <kind>:base. The FRONTEND defaultView() is the source of truth; the backend _default_view_spec() must match. Asserted by frontend defaultView.golden.test.ts AND backend test_views.py::test_default_view_specs_match_frontend so the two hand-written builders can't drift (#271 / finding-2). `params` is compared so a default that declares a runtime formal can't drift between the two builders; no default declares one today (#1816 moved the assistants tag filter to the pane's search field), but the guard stays for the next. Update this when the default shape intentionally changes.
